{{Top|leg}}
'''Frampemmi soup''' was a type of [[Soup/Legends|soup]]. It was served at [[The Broken Tusk (Reuss VIII)|The Broken Tusk]] on [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]]. [[Cohden K'Reye]] noted that the level of service at The Broken Tusk meant that [[Waiter/Legends|waiters]] were likely to spit in the soup if a customer annoyed them.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
